comments.note: testForceTagsClosedFalse sets a temporary error handler to detect E_DEPRECATED notices. This pattern is robust because PHPUnit 12 does not by default convert E_DEPRECATED to exceptions in the same way for user-installed error handlers; using set_error_handler gives direct control over detection.
